description: Every tool POST /mcp offers. Written by scripts/mcp_json.sh from the registered tools; do not edit by hand. tools.description: The account this API key belongs to, the role it acts with (role -- never higher than the key's own scope), and the account's own role.
tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I

tools.description: People with an active account, a page at a time: id and display name. Use the id wherever another tool asks for a user. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: list_team
tools.title: List team

tools.description: Accounts, a page at a time, including disabled ones, with each one's role and which is the owner. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: admin_list_users
tools.title: List users (admin)

tools.description: Switch an account off (disabled: true) or back on (false). Disabling signs it out everywhere and voids its live login link; its API keys stop working while it is off. Reversible. The owner and your own account cannot be disabled.

user_id.description: The account's id, from list_team or admin_list_users.

tools.name: admin_set_user_disabled
tools.title: Disable or enable a user (admin)

tools.description: For an account that may be compromised: ends every session and voids its live login link and every API key it holds, at once. The account stays enabled; someone with a browser session must issue a new login link to let its owner back in. The owner and your own account cannot be revoked.

user_id.description: The account's id, from list_team or admin_list_users.

tools.name: admin_revoke_access
tools.title: Revoke a user's access (admin)

tools.description: Change your own display name (1-80 characters). expect, when given, is the name you think it has now; if someone changed it meanwhile the rename is refused with the current name, so nothing is overwritten unseen.

expect.description: The current name, from whoami. Optional.

tools.name: rename_account
tools.title: Rename your account

tools.description: Replace your whole list of color themes (1 to 40) and pick the one you use. themes: null goes back to following the app's defaults. A theme is the Theme schema in the API reference (config/openapi.json): id, name, mode light|dark, accent, second, optional colors as #rrggbb, and optional labels [{name, color}] that are added to a board when the theme is picked for it. whoami shows the current list.
tools.name: set_themes
tools.title: Replace your own themes

tools.description: Switch to another theme from your list (or the defaults), by its id.
tools.name: set_theme
tools.title: Pick your theme

tools.description: The theme list everyone without their own list sees. themes is null while the built-in ones apply.
tools.name: admin_get_theme_defaults
tools.title: Default themes (admin)

tools.description: Replace the theme list everyone without their own list sees, 1 to 40 themes in the Theme schema of the API reference. null puts the built-in themes back.
tools.name: admin_set_theme_defaults
tools.title: Replace the default themes (admin)

tools.description: Group invite links, a page at a time: label, places used and left, expiry, and whether each still works. The links themselves are never shown again after creation. next is the offset of the following page, or null on the last one.

offset.description: Rows to skip: the next value of the previous page.

tools.name: admin_list_invite_links
tools.title: List invite links (admin)

tools.description: Stop an invite link from letting anyone else join or sign in through it. Accounts it already made keep working. Cannot be switched back on.
tools.name: admin_revoke_invite_link
tools.title: Switch off an invite link (admin)

tools.description: Every board you own or are a member of (id, slug, title, your role, folder), your home-page folders, and single cards shared with you from boards you are not on.
tools.name: list_boards
tools.title: List my boards

tools.description: A board as you can see it: its notes, its purpose if the board has that section on (board.purpose says what the board is for and how to work on it, so read it first), columns (lists), labels, members, and the cards you may see, with each card's column, labels, assignees, dates, checklist and rev. people maps user ids to names. Archived cards are left out unless include_archived is true.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

tools.name: get_board
tools.title: Read a board

annotations.title: Read a board's purpose and notes

tools.description: Just the board's notes and purpose, without its cards. notes holds links, documents and reference material. purpose says what the board is for and how to work on it, and is only there when purpose_enabled is true. Both are markdown, and may be empty. Read them before working on a board. The revs go back to update_board_notes.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

tools.name: get_board_notes
tools.title: Read a board's purpose and notes

annotations.title: Change a board's purpose or notes

tools.description: Replace a board's notes, its purpose, or both; leave out what should not change. A board's purpose can only be written while its Purpose section is on, which a person does in Board settings. Each is the whole new markdown text, so to add a link, send the old notes with it added. Each needs the rev it was read at, from get_board_notes or get_board: if someone edited the text since, the change is refused rather than written over theirs. Needs edit rights on the board.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

purpose.description: Markdown: what the board is for and how to work on it.

tools.name: update_board_notes
tools.title: Change a board's purpose or notes

tools.description: One card in full: title, description, column, labels, assignees, dates, checklist, and rev (pass rev back to update_card when changing the title or description).

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: Read a card

tools.description: A card's comments, oldest first: who wrote each (by: a member's name, "guest:Name" for a guest, "guest:" for an anonymous one) and when.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: Read a card's comments

tools.description: Post a comment on a card, signed with your name. Markdown, up to 4000 characters. Needs edit rights on the card, or a card shared with you to comment on.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Comment on a card

tools.description: Search the cards you can see, across all your boards or one. query matches title and description (case-insensitive). Done and archived cards are left out unless asked for. Returns compact rows, soonest due first; use get_card for the full card.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

due_before.description: Only cards due before this: "2026-10-30" or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

tools.name: find_cards
tools.title: Find cards

tools.description: A new board owned by you, with the given columns in order (for example ["To do", "Doing", "Done"]); a board always gets at least three, so fewer are padded out. Returns its id and slug.
tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create a board

tools.description: A new board owned by you, copied from one you can open: its settings, notes, labels, columns, and the cards you can see with their checklists. Comments, card pictures, members and share links are not copied. Returns the copy's id and slug.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

tools.name: duplicate_board
tools.title: Duplicate a board

tools.description: Add a column (list) to a board. Needs edit rights on the whole board.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

position.description: Sort position within the column; lower comes first. Leave out to put it at the end.

tools.name: create_list
tools.title: Add a column

annotations.title: Rename, move or archive a column

tools.description: Change a column's title or position, archive it (archived: true hides it; false brings it back), or on a staged board fix the stage it shows for everyone (stage_view; empty follows the navbar), or give it its own To do/Doing/Done buttons (stage_tabs: on, off, or empty to follow the board's setting). Leave out what should not change.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

position.description: Sort position within the column; lower comes first. Leave out to put it at the end.

tools.name: update_list
tools.title: Rename, move or archive a column

tools.description: Add a label to a board, to put on cards with update_card's label_ids. Needs edit rights on the whole board.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

color.description: A palette name (blue, green, orange, red, purple, pink, teal, gray, yellow) or a #rrggbb colour.

tools.name: create_label
tools.title: Add a label

tools.description: Add a card to a column. The other fields are optional and set in the same call. Needs edit rights on that column.

assignees.description: User ids, from get_board's members or list_team.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

day.description: On a calendar board (layout "calendar"), the day the card is filed under: "2026-11-07", or "" for none.

doing.description: On a staged board, the Doing stage. true starts the card (reopening it if done); done: true moves it on to Done.

due_at.description: "2026-10-30" for an all-day date, an RFC 3339 timestamp for a time, "" to clear.

position.description: Sort position within the column; lower comes first. Leave out to put it at the end.

rank_place.description: Importance across the whole board: 1 is the most important, and other cards shift to make room. 0 takes the card out of the ranking. Needs edit rights on the board.

start_at.description: "2026-10-30" for an all-day date, an RFC 3339 timestamp for a time, "" to clear.

tools.name: create_card
tools.title: Add a card

tools.description: Change any of a card's fields; leave out what should not change. Moving it (list_id, position) or archiving it needs edit rights on its column, and on the whole board to move it to another column. done marks it complete; doing and rank_place are the Doing stage and board-wide importance of a staged board. archived: true hides it from the board (reversible). Pass the card's rev when changing title or description: if someone edited it since, the change is refused rather than written over theirs.

assignees.description: The full set of user ids; replaces the current assignees.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

day.description: On a calendar board (layout "calendar"), the day the card is filed under: "2026-11-07", or "" for none.

doing.description: On a staged board, the Doing stage. true starts the card (reopening it if done); done: true moves it on to Done.

due_at.description: "2026-10-30" for an all-day date, an RFC 3339 timestamp for a time, "" to clear.

label_ids.description: The full set; replaces the current labels.

position.description: Sort position within the column; lower comes first. Leave out to put it at the end.

rank_place.description: Importance across the whole board: 1 is the most important, and other cards shift to make room. 0 takes the card out of the ranking. Needs edit rights on the board.

start_at.description: "2026-10-30" for an all-day date, an RFC 3339 timestamp for a time, "" to clear.

tools.name: update_card
tools.title: Change a card

tools.description: Add an item to the end of a card's checklist. Returns the card.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.title: Add a checklist item

annotations.title: Tick or edit a checklist item

tools.description: Tick an item off (done: true) or back on, change its text, or move it. Item ids are in the card's checklist. Returns the card.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.title: Tick or edit a checklist item

annotations.title: Send a card to another board

tools.description: Move a card to another board, whole: it keeps its link, comments and picture. Labels are matched by name there (made if missing), assignees kept only if they are on that board, and per-person shares dropped. Needs edit rights on both boards.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

list_id.description: The column on to_board it goes into, from get_board.

to_board.description: The board it goes to: id or URL slug, from list_boards.

top.description: Put it at the top of the column instead of the end.

tools.name: send_card
tools.title: Send a card to another board

annotations.title: Copy a card to a board

tools.description: Copy a card onto any board (its own included) with its content, comments and picture, optionally kept in step with the original (mirror). Needs edit rights where the copy goes, and on the card for a mirror.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

list_id.description: The column on to_board it goes into, from get_board.

mirror.description: "" for a plain copy; "one_way" to keep the copy following the original (the copy's synced fields become read-only); "two_way" to keep both in step. Synced: title, description, checklist, dates, price, picture, To do/Doing/Done, comments.

to_board.description: The board it goes to: id or URL slug, from list_boards.

top.description: Put it at the top of the column instead of the end.

tools.name: copy_card
tools.title: Copy a card to a board

tools.description: The cards this one is kept in step with: each link's id, mode (one_way / two_way), direction (out: this card's changes flow there; in: this card follows that one; both), and the other card.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: list_card_links
tools.title: List a card's mirrors

tools.description: End one of a card's mirror links (link_id from list_card_links). Both cards stay as they are.

board.description: The board's id or URL slug, from list_boards.

card_id.description: The card's id, from get_board or find_cards.

tools.name: unlink_card
tools.title: Stop mirroring a card

transport: Streamable HTTP, stateless: one JSON-RPC message per POST, a JSON reply
